definitions.explanation: The manner or method of doing something. A general, everyday word for approach or technique.

examples.japanese: やり{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please teach me how to do it.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}のやり{方|かた}が{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I don't understand how to use this machine.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いやり{方|かた}を{変|か}えて、{新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}を{試|ため}してみよう。
examples.english: Let's change the old way of doing things and try a new method.

notes:
やり{方|かた} is formed from やる (to do) + {方|かた} (way). It is one of the most common ~{方|かた} compounds.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方法|ほうほう}: method (more formal, written)
- {仕方|しかた}: way of doing (slightly more formal)
- やり{方|かた}: way of doing (casual, everyday)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- やり{方|かた}が{分|わ}からない (don't know how to do it)
- やり{方|かた}を{変|か}える (change the way of doing things)
- やり{方|かた}を{覚|おぼ}える (learn how to do something)

cross_references.label: style, manner, way of doing things
